labels.notes: Correctly UNMARKED (single backticks, Prop4Tore.lean:11; SCOPE says no mark changes; REPORT status partial). The file is an instance (w = simplexO 1, p = 2) giving evidence on the OQ-171 reading, not Prop. 4 itself, and it says so. (1) IsCompatibleAssocPiOne (Prop4Tore.lean:90) is IsCompatibleAssocPi (ConverseGeneral.lean:326, Ch. 1 Def. 2) with the torus factor fixed to 1: same sigma, same phi_i : F(B_sigma(i)) -> F(B_i) with IsConeIso, same formula m'_i = phi_i m_sigma(i). isCompatibleAssocPiOne_iff shows the equivalence with t = 1 (map_one, one_smul), and torus_ne_one_of_not_compatibleOne shows that its negation is exactly 'every Def. 2 representation has t != 1'. So it faithfully formalizes 'compatible with t = 1'. (2) Quantifier order in simplexO_one_prop4_tore (l.472): for all l, k, b, hB, Psi with IsProjIso, there EXISTS f with IsCompatiblePi (transport f) and not (exists sigma, IsCompatibleAssocPiOne sigma (transport f)). That is forall Psi, exists f, as required, and it is stronger than fixing prop4_produit's Psi0. (3) The finding rests on IsConeIso being a GU(n+1) morphism (|det| = 1), so that on the cone of a point of S(0) the only conical automorphism is the identity. This is Benzecri's own definition (ch1.tex l.489-512: the conical affine structure has charts with g_ij in GU(n, R)), not a library artefact, so the counting argument (at most 2! = 2 compatible-with-t=1 automorphisms against infinitely many diag(1, j+1)) is sound against the paper. (4) No not_ declaration, and that is right: Prop. 4 as printed (compatibility with a torus factor allowed) is untouched on this w. Only a reading of the one-line proof ('element de GP(n, R)' read as t = 1) is refuted. The finding is worded as evidence for OQ-171, not as an error of the paper.

lemmas_checked.coneIso_eq_self: True and non-vacuous: its hypothesis (B a subsingleton open of S(0)) is met by Prop. 4's B_i on the segment (subsingleton_of_convex_F, discharged in simplexO_one_prop4_tore), and a nonempty point open exists. Its conclusion is the paper-level fact that GU(1) = {+-1} preserves a half-line only as +1.
lemmas_checked.ncard_compatibleOne_le: A true upper bound. The finiteness half is what gets used. Uniqueness per sigma comes from coneIso_unique plus FaithfulSMul. The bound is (q+1)!, through range of a choice function on Perm (Fin (q+1)). Not vacuous: the set contains 1 (isCompatibleAssocPiOne_one).
lemmas_checked.infinite_aut: Real. diagAut j = s(diag(1, j+1)) preserves the positive quadrant (diagL_mem_iff), and diagAut_injective evaluates at s(1,1) and compares rays.
lemmas_checked.transportAut_injective: Real. Psi^-1 f Psi determines f, by FaithfulSMul and Psi.symm injective. Used with Set.Finite.preimage to pull back finiteness.
lemmas_checked.isCompatiblePi_transportAut: Correct: compatibility is a subgroup (compatibleSubgroup), and Psi^-1 f Psi = a^-1 (Psi0^-1 f Psi0) a with a itself a transport along Psi0.

findings.what: The argument depends on conical isomorphisms being GU (|det| = 1) morphisms. That is Benzecri's own definition (ch1.tex l.495, l.512), but neither the REPORT nor the docstring cites it. A reader could take the finding for an artefact of IsConeIso: with GL+ conical maps (homotheties allowed), t = 1 representations would exist on the segment.
